L158: The Family Pokémon Card Game (Japanese: ファミリーポケモンカードゲーム) is a cite51†Pokémon Trading Card Game product that was released in Japan on July 9, 2021, Taiwan and Hong Kong on August 6, 2021, South Korea on November 27, 2021 and Mainland China on November 17, 2023.

L172: Much like the original cite47†Family Pokémon Card Game set released during the Sun & Moon Era, this iteration is designed to introduce children and their families to the TCG by featuring cards with relatively basic effects and including step-by-step guides on how to play the game. The set includes three 60-card decks that each focus on two cite50†types and incorporate cite58†Pokémon V cards to represent them. Three of these are the namesake for each deck: cite59†Cinderace , cite60†Pikachu , and cite61†Tyranitar .
L173: The decks share a collective numbering system and set symbol; each card also features a colored silhouette of the appropriate focal Pokémon to denote which deck it belongs to. The set also comes with a pair of battle guides, a beginner's guide, a battle record sheet, a full-size playmat, a set of color-coded deck bands, a damage counter case, and a cardboard sheet containing damage counters, status markers, and an extra-large cite62†coin .
L174: The battle guides are also available as video on YouTube. In order for players to follow the guides, 17 cards in the Cinderace V deck and 19 cards in the Pikachu V deck have "teaching numbers" printed over their Pokémon silhouettes, and players are required to start the game with the numbered cards placed on the top of their decks in order instead of fully-shuffled decks.
L175: Also, all trainer and energy cards in the Japanese version had their card headers printed in Japanese instead of English, a feature inherited from the original Sun & Moon set.
L176: The expansion mark assigned to this set is SH in all languages except Simplified Chinese, whose expansion mark is CS2Da. Although the Simplified Chinese set has a different expansion mark, contents within the product and card lists are exactly the same as other languages.
L177: A smaller version of the set designed to be carried around was available from the same day—the Family Pokémon Card Game Anytime, Anywhere (Japanese: いつでもどこでもファミリーポケモンカード). This version only includes the Cinderace V and Pikachu V decks, plus a pair of single-player playmats, a regular-sized plastic coin, a pair of deck cases, and a sheet containing damage counters and status markers.
L178: Physical copies of the battle guides are not included, but players can view the video instead by scanning the QR code printed on the back of the playmats. Another difference in this version is that all Pokémon V cards included are non-holofoil instead of the regular holofoil copies in the 3-deck version.
L179: The "Anytime, Anywhere" version was later released in Thai on November 26, 2021. As the full 3-deck set was never released in Thailand, cards found only in Tyranitar V deck were excluded from the Thai card list, reducing the list to 38 cards instead of 53 in other regions. All Thai cards are also renumbered to 0**/038 to reflect their places in the Thai card list.

L4: # 联袂登场，尽享对战乐趣！ 宝可梦卡牌简中版第二弹商品——〖交相辉映〗火热出击

L6: ## 目录
L7: 
L8: ###
L9: 
L10: 宝可梦卡牌简中版〖太阳&月亮〗第二弹商品——〖交相辉映〗将于2023年1月18日10时起正式发售！
L11: 
L12: 本次〖交相辉映〗商品包含起始卡组〖交相辉映GX〗以及3款补充包，分别为〖沐〗、〖魁〗、〖唤〗。大家期待已久的〖TAG TEAM〗也会在第二弹商品里和训练家见面。强力且独特的〖TAG TEAM〗会为对战带来怎样的变化呢，来和我们一起一探究竟吧！
L13: 
L14: ## 〖TAG TEAM〗
L15: 
L16: 〖TAG TEAM〗是在宝可梦卡牌简中版〖太阳&月亮〗第二弹商品——〖交相辉映〗中加入的一系列强力卡牌，它分为〖TAG TEAM GX〗以及〖TAG TEAM支援者〗。
L17: #### 什么是〖TAG TEAM GX〗？
L18: 
L19: cite0†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L20: 
L21: 〖TAG TEAM GX〗是非常强力的宝可梦GX卡牌，它们通常既拥有高额HP，也能够瞬间使对手战斗场上或是备战区的宝可梦陷入昏厥，是卡组里不折不扣的实力担当。
L22: 
L23: cite1†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn cite2†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L24: 
L25: 〖TAG TEAM GX〗的GX招式如果追加附有能量的话，还能启动更为强大的效果！
L26: 
L27: 例如太阳伊布&代欧奇希斯GX的〖交叉分配GX〗，当它附着了1个超属性能量和2个任意属性能量时即可发动，可将10个伤害指示物以任意方式放置于对手的宝可梦身上，一旦追加附有3个任意属性能量，可放置的伤害指示物数量剧增为20个！
L28: 
L29: 月亮伊布&达克莱伊GX的〖亡月GX〗，发动条件仅为1个任意属性能量，效果为下一个对手的回合，对手将无法从手牌中使出训练家卡牌。然而追加附有5个恶属性能量的话，可使对手的战斗宝可梦直接昏厥。瞬间减员+限制手牌使用，战局从此刻逆转。
L30: 如此强力的〖TAG TEAM GX〗在使用上也必须小心，一旦你的〖TAG TEAM GX〗陷入昏厥后，对手可是会因此获取3张奖赏卡哦。
L31: #### 什么是〖TAG TEAM 支援者〗？
L32: 
L33: 〖TAG TEAM支援者〗是非常独特的支援者卡牌，除了为你提供各种支援外，满足条件后还可以追加发动各种强力的效果。
L34: 
L35: cite3†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn cite4†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L36: 
L37: 玛奥&水莲使用后可将自己的战斗宝可梦和备战宝可梦互换，若使用的同时弃掉2张手牌的话，被换到备战区的宝可梦还可追加回复120点HP。竹兰&嘉德丽雅也是同样，使用时若选择弃掉一张手牌，追加效果为从自己牌库上方抽取3张卡牌。
L38: 
L39: ## 〖交相辉映〗部分卡牌介绍
L40: 
L41: 我们将从补充包〖沐〗、〖魁〗、〖唤〗开始带大家领略〖交相辉映〗的独特魅力。
L42: 
L43: ### 补充包〖沐〗篇：
L44: 
L45: cite5†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L46: 
L47: 补充包〖沐〗收录了包含水、雷、钢属性宝可梦以及配套使用的训练家卡牌。
L48: #### 封面宝可梦：呆呆兽&可达鸭GX：
L49: 
L50: cite6†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L51: 
L52: 呆萌可爱的呆呆兽和可达鸭不可错过
L53: 
L54: 呆呆兽&可达鸭GX作为基础宝可梦拥有250点HP，上场后可吸引一定的火力。2个水属性能量即可发动的〖丢丢飞溅〗可弃掉手牌中的支援者卡牌，造成丢弃数量x40点伤害。
L55: 
L56: 〖心动时间GX〗能造成10点基础伤害，在2个水属性能量发动时可抛一次硬币，若为正面则追加100点伤害。若追加附着6个水属性能量，也就是说在附着8个水属性能量的情况下发动，抛掷硬币的次数变为10次，理论上可造成1010点的超高额爆炸伤害！心动不如行动，勇敢地去抛硬币吧！
L57: 
L58: #### 推荐搭配使用：小霞的愿望+拉普拉斯
L59: 
L60: cite7†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn cite8†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L61: 
L62: 小霞的愿望可以快速为手牌添加支援者卡牌，配合呆呆兽&可达鸭GX的〖丢丢飞溅〗能造成可观的伤害。同时拉普拉斯的特性〖人鱼呼唤〗又能将弃牌区中的一张小霞的愿望加入手牌。有这两张卡牌的辅助，呆呆兽&可达鸭GX就可以成为你稳定的火力点持续造成伤害。
L63: #### 补充包〖沐〗中收录的其他宝可梦：
L64: 
L65: cite9†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn cite10†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn cite11†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L66: 
L67: *以上卡牌均收录于补充包〖沐〗。
L68: 
L69: 补充包〖魁〗篇：
L70: 
L71: cite12†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L72: 
L73: 补充包〖魁〗收录了包含草、超、斗属性宝可梦以及配套使用的训练家卡牌。
L74: 
L75: #### 封面宝可梦：耿鬼&谜拟丘GX：
L76: 
L77: cite13†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L78: 
L79: 调皮的耿鬼和可爱的谜拟丘会撞出怎样的火花
L80: 
L81: 在对战中，若你派出耿鬼&谜拟丘GX上场，对手的头痛时间就到了。
L82: 
L83: 〖灵骚〗能根据对手手牌里所拥有的的训练家卡牌数量造成对应的伤害，更重要的是你还可以查看对手的手牌。有耿鬼&谜拟丘GX在场，战局尽在你的掌握之中。
L84: 
L85: 〖鬼屋GX〗在附着1个超属性能量时的效果为下一个对手的回合内，对手无法从手牌中使出卡牌。若附着了2个超属性能量，双方还可各从牌库上方抽取卡牌，直到手牌变为7张为止。看准时机使用，用你的鬼灵精怪赢取胜利吧。
L86: #### 推荐搭配使用：惊吓箱+多刺菊石兽
L87: 
L88: cite14†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn cite15†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L89: 
L90: 对手手牌中训练家卡牌越多，耿鬼&谜拟丘GX的〖灵骚〗造成的伤害就越高。通过使用惊吓箱，将对手弃牌区中的训练家卡牌放回对手手牌以提高伤害，抑或将对手故意想弃掉的卡牌再还给对手打乱节奏都是很好的选择。多刺菊石兽在己方场上宝可梦数量少于对手宝可梦的话，对手将无法从手牌中使用物品，使用得当能让对手加倍头痛。
L91: 
L92: #### 补充包〖魁〗中收录的其他宝可梦：
L93: 
L94: cite16†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn cite17†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn cite18†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L95: 
L96: *以上卡牌均收录于补充包〖魁〗。
L97: 
L98: ### 补充包〖唤〗篇：
L99: 
L100: cite19†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L101: 
L102: 补充包〖唤〗收录了包含火、恶、妖属性宝可梦以及配套使用的训练家卡牌
L103: #### 封面宝可梦：伊布&卡比兽GX：
L104: 
L105: cite20†Image†image.pokemon.com.cn L106: 
L107: 伊布和它的好朋友卡比兽一起为你应援
L108:

L8: ## 宝可梦卡牌〖剑&盾：极巨争锋〗即将发售

L21: 宝可梦V通常具备高额的HP，例如〖伊布V〗作为基础宝可梦就拥有190点的HP。宝可梦V均为基础宝可梦，不仅可直接加入战场，还能通过〖V进化〗，进化成更为强大的宝可梦VMAX。

L28: 
L29: 作为一张拥有高额HP、强力干扰招式的卡牌，伊布VMAX将成为你战场上的可靠小伙伴。

L148: The Shining Synergy GX Starter Deck (Simplified Chinese: GX起始卡组 交相辉映) is a Simplified Chinese-exclusive cite45†Pokémon Trading Card Game deck with random elements that was released in cite46†mainland China on January 18, 2023.
L149: ## Information
L150: 
L151: Each GX Starter Deck includes 60 cards comprising two randomly paired 30-card groups. Each group has a selection of Pokémon cards that typically focus on one cite44†type , an assortment of cite47†Trainer cards , and multiples of supporting basic cite48†Energy cards . The two card groups each have 20 possible varieties.
L152: GX Starter Decks are also packaged with a cardboard sheet containing damage counters, cite49†Special Condition markers, and a GX marker; a rulesheet; and a bonus booster pack containing one of 40 possible cards. Twenty-five of these are Trainer cards that can also be found in the deck, while 15 cite50†Secret cards can only be found in the bonus pack. All cards have a collection number and set symbol specific to the deck, but do not feature any rarity symbols.
L153: All Secret cards are Holofoil, while all other cards are Non Holofoil.
L154: cite51†Sky Pillar was the subject of an erratum issued on October 19, 2023 after it was identified that the card had incorrectly been given the "C" cite52†regulation mark instead of the "B" regulation mark; the erratum revised its official regulation mark to "B" to bring it in line with other prints.

L163: The Happy Set is similar to the cite53†Battle Party Set released during the Simplified Chinese Sun & Moon Series, offering multiple decks and customization options to support different playstyles. Sets include four 60-card decks that focus on cite54†Pikachu , cite55†Clefairy , cite56†Turtwig , and cite57†Gimmighoul . The decks share a numbering system and set code; each card also features a colored silhouette of the focal Pokémon to denote which deck it belongs to. Each deck is sealed with a gameplay introduction card.
L164: The decks can be adapted with cards from the enclosed Modification Pack. Each pack includes two different Pokémon cards, three different Item cards, two different Pokémon Tool cards, and three different Supporter cards from a pool of 23 cards. Of the Pokémon cards available, Cyclizar ex has a 3.1% chance of being obtained. Happy Sets also come with a Reward Pack, which contains one of 14 Holofoil cards, and seven cite58†Collection 151 event packs, which contain two cards from the subset.
L165: There is an 87.5% chance the Reward Pack will contain a Basic Energy card and a 12.5% chance it will contain a Pokémon card.^{cite59†[1] }
L166: Sets are packaged with a player beginner's guide that outlines the basic rules of the TCG and a game rules instruction sheet with suggestions for various styles of games that can be conducted between two, three, and four players. Also included are a pair of battle guides, four cardboard sheets containing damage counters and status markers, as well as two extra large-sized cardboard cite60†coins bearing the cite61†Pokémon ex logo.
L167: The Pikachu and Clefairy decks serve as beginner decks and several cards feature "teaching numbers" superimposed on the Pokémon silhouettes to indicate the order in which they should be played when following the enclosed battle guides.
L168: A smaller version of the Happy Set, named the Pikachu & Clefairy & Turtwig & Gimmighoul Happy Deck (Simplified Chinese: 嗨皮卡组 皮卡丘&皮皮&草苗龟&索财灵), was made available from the same day. This product includes one of the four decks at random, a beginner's guide, and a cardboard sheet of damage counters and status markers; however, the Modification Pack, Reward Pack, instruction sheet, battle guides, and coins are not included.
L169: Additionally, each deck from either product has a 1.6% chance of containing Holofoil versions of its cards.^{cite59†[1] } With these variants, Pokémon ex feature their regular Holofoil styling, while other cards have a Mirror Holofoil treatment.
